c96d52.title: Recon: malpoth.com Attack Surface Summary
c96d52.content:
## Target Overview
- **malpoth.com**: "Verified Land & Property Listings in Nepal | Lekhaprati" - Real estate platform
- **api.malpoth.com**: REST API backend (minimal root response, 12 bytes)

## Technology Stack
- Next.js (Turbopack) + React + Node.js + Webpack
- Cloudflare WAF on both targets
- HTTP/3, TLS 1.3, HSTS (API only)
- IPs: 172.67.143.153, 104.21.27.219 (Cloudflare)

## Discovered Endpoints (12 unique functional URLs)
- `/` - Homepage with property listings
- `/?category=apartments` - Category filter (parameterized)
- `/gold` - Premium/gold tier section
- `/area-guid` - Area guide pages
- `/about` - About page
- `/scrape` - Unusual endpoint, needs investigation
- `/nrn-concierge` - Concierge service
- `/cart` - Shopping cart (e-commerce)
- `/?auth=signin&redirect=%2Fcart` - Auth flow with redirect parameter
- `/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection` - Cloudflare email obfuscation

## Open Ports
- malpoth.com: 80, 8080, 8443
- api.malpoth.com: 80, 443, 8443

## Subdomains
- Only api.malpoth.com found (no additional subdomains via subfinder/crt.sh)

## High-Priority Testing Vectors
1. **Auth redirect parameter** (`?auth=signin&redirect=`) - Test for open redirect
2. **Cart functionality** - Business logic, race conditions, price manipulation
3. **/scrape endpoint** - Unusual name, could be SSRF or data extraction
4. **Search form** (parameter `q`) - XSS, SQLi testing
5. **API endpoints** - IDOR, BOLA, authentication bypass
6. **Next.js specific** - Server-side rendering issues, RSC vulnerabilities
</content>
